verdict_reason: Simple response record; only a Minor gap on defensive copying and null guards compared with its siblings.

todos.issue: CommodityGroup takes the service's mutable ArrayList as species without a defensive copy (CommoditySearchService line 58 passes the speciesByCode map value straight in), while its sibling records CommoditySearchResponse, SpeciesCheckRequest and SpeciesCheckResponse all copy their lists with List.copyOf. A public record crossing the API boundary also has no null guard on code or species.
todos.fix: Must: CommodityGroup is immutable like its sibling records, holding its own unmodifiable copy of species, and rejects a null code or species list. One way: add a compact constructor with Objects.requireNonNull(code, "code") and species = List.copyOf(species).
